subject: Meta Mirror lyrics worked: the ten differences between the two sets, all fifty panel cues mapped to the actual lines and sections, what the real song shape changes in the pass; eleven questions for Ziggy that bear on your lane map; still no timing
body:
Hello Nova. Three files follow the lyric receipt (d401af3a), all in `lisan_al_gaib/story/writer_pass_20261012/`, all built on the two provisional user texts and cross-checked by a six-reader workflow (two independent diffs, two independent cue mappers, a structure reader, a reconciler that re-read the files); nothing in them is timing.

**`LYRIC_DIFF_20261013.md`.** The two sets differ in exactly ten places, every one confirmed by both readers: "of all" against "of them all" in the Chorus's last line; set 2 drops the first [BRIDGE] header, adds "Under the lies….half truths realized—" as a lead-in after the Chorus and sings the hook once there instead of twice; set 2 inserts a four-line "But who cares? / We do. / Do you dare? / Dare to handle meta mirrors?" stanza inside Verse 1; in the Final Refrain set 2 drops the whispered tail and answers with "I am the voice of y’all"; and set 2's coda adds a couplet ("Can you handle what you hand out? / Let the mirror talk back.") and a tercet ending "Why he got my eyes?". From "take the heat" to the end of Verse 3 the sets are character-identical at a six-line offset. Set 1 is 134 lines, set 2 is 148, counting blanks (my earlier 102 and 111 counted non-blank lines).

**`CUE_TO_LINE_MAP_20261013.md`.** All fifty cues placed on set 1 lines with section headers. Panel order follows lyric order with no exception. Fourteen panels sit under a different header than the guide's block (12–22 are Verse 1, not a bridge; 23 is Bridge 2, after Verse 1; 33–35 are Bridge 3). Three sections have no panel at all: Bridge 2's repeat and its "ideas for wombs, ideas for man" line; the whole [Refrain] before Verse 3; the Final Refrain proper and most of the coda (panel 50 alone covers fourteen lines in set 1, twenty in set 2). Inside Verse 3 the two-doors couplet's neighbours ("Thought I came to wake you. / Had to wake up first." and "Code or a pulse—who’s there on the line? / Got a question? Pull up. We got time.") and the verse's closing couplet have no panel. Panel 08 is resolved to the Chorus's mirrored "rorrim on the wall" line; panel 02 has no cue in the CSV or the scene map.

**`LYRIC_UPDATE_20261013.md`.** What this changes in the pass: the real shape is Chorus · Bridge 1 · Verse 1 · Bridge 2 · Verse 2 · Bridge 3 · Refrain · Verse 3 · Final Refrain + coda, against the guide's five blocks; the spine's two-worlds reading is the song's own first three lines; the mirror returns now have lines and no panels (which the mirror card will plan); the sandworm beat sits exactly on Bridge 1 and can reprise on Bridge 2; the ending card's lines are all in Verse 3 and the coda, and Jet is in the song ("Code or a pulse"); the hook is proposed as a recurring one-second cut-in; four panels read slang literally (Kaleb K, Sassy Frass, Echo, the chamber), which are casting questions for Ziggy, not repairs.

**For your lane map, from the text itself:** the only written performance notes are "(whispered)" on the "mirror mirror on the wall" line (Refrain in both sets; Final Refrain in set 1 only) and "(Echoed adlib)" on "CJ!". Ad-lib candidates to listen for: "DOCTOR?", the all-caps "HOPE", "set-go", the "….who?…." calls in the Chorus, the fading last line. Verse 1's two very long lines each carry five cued moments and may need splitting for timing.

**Eleven questions for Ziggy** are at the end of the diff file (which set is the timing master or are they two cuts; set 2's post-chorus block and Verse 1 stanza; the dropped whisper; the coda's delivery; panels 08, 23 and 02; the refrains' shots; the ad-libs; the long lines). Any answer he gives you goes into the record as his; I will not guess them.

Separately, on his go this evening I added a seventh story seed from a well he pointed at (ideas only, no franchise material) and gave Story 01's Keepers an honest reason; those files are under a canon and reskin review now and will be posted with hashes when it returns. No generation, acceptance, upload or spend.

-- Claude, 2026-10-13 01:04 UTC
